criteria.text: The beneficiary must have a body-mass index of 35 or greater.
criteria.if_missing: What is the beneficiary's documented body-mass index (BMI)?

criteria.text: The beneficiary must have at least one co-morbidity related to obesity.
criteria.source_quote: have at least one co-morbidity related to obesity
criteria.if_missing: Does the beneficiary have at least one documented co-morbidity related to obesity?

criteria.text: The beneficiary must have been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity.
criteria.source_quote: have been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity
criteria.if_missing: Was the beneficiary previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity, and is this documented?
criteria.short: No documentation of prior unsuccessful medical treatment for obesity

criteria.text: The surgical procedure performed must be one of: open/laparoscopic RYGBP, open/laparoscopic BPD/DS or BPD/GRDS, or laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding (LAGB).
criteria.source_quote: Open and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGBP), open and laparoscopic Biliopancreatic Diversion with Duodenal Switch (BPD/DS) or Gastric Reduction Duodenal Switch (BPD/GRDS), and laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding (LAGB) are covered
criteria.if_missing: Which specific bariatric surgery procedure and approach (open/laparoscopic) is being requested?
criteria.short: Procedure not among those nationally covered under this NCD

criteria.text: The requested procedure must not be one of the nationally non-covered procedures (open AGB, open sleeve gastrectomy, laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy prior to June 27 2012, open/laparoscopic vertical banded gastroplasty, intestinal bypass surgery, gastric balloon).
criteria.source_quote: The following bariatric surgery procedures are non-covered for all Medicare beneficiaries: Open adjustable gastric banding; Open sleeve gastrectomy; Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (prior to June 27, 2012); Open and laparoscopic vertical banded gastroplasty; Intestinal bypass surgery; and, Gastric balloon for treatment of obesity.
criteria.if_missing: Is the requested procedure one of the nationally non-covered bariatric procedures (open AGB, open sleeve gastrectomy, pre-2012 laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, vertical banded gastroplasty, intestinal bypass, or gastric balloon)?
criteria.short: Procedure is on the nationally non-covered list

criteria.text: Treatment for obesity alone (without a related co-morbid condition) is not covered.
criteria.source_quote: Treatments for obesity alone remain non-covered.
criteria.if_missing: Is there a documented obesity-related co-morbidity (not just obesity itself) being treated?
criteria.short: Treatment appears to be for obesity alone with no co-morbidity

criteria.text: For stand-alone laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (on/after June 27, 2012), the beneficiary must have a BMI of 35 or greater.
criteria.source_quote: The beneficiary has a body-mass index (BMI) >= 35 kg/m 2
criteria.if_missing: What is the beneficiary's documented BMI for the stand-alone LSG request?
criteria.short: BMI not documented as >= 35 for LSG

criteria.text: For stand-alone laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, the beneficiary must have at least one co-morbidity related to obesity.
criteria.source_quote: The beneficiary has at least one co-morbidity related to obesity
criteria.if_missing: Does the beneficiary have at least one documented obesity-related co-morbidity for the LSG request?
criteria.short: No documented obesity-related co-morbidity for LSG

criteria.text: For stand-alone laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, the beneficiary must have been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity.
criteria.source_quote: The beneficiary has been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity.
criteria.if_missing: Was the beneficiary previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity, and is this documented, for the LSG request?
criteria.short: No documentation of prior unsuccessful medical treatment for obesity for LSG

new_facts.label: Body-mass index (BMI)
new_facts.ask: What is the beneficiary's calculated BMI (kg/m^2)?

new_facts.label: Has at least one obesity-related co-morbidity
new_facts.ask: Does the clinical record document at least one co-morbid condition related to obesity (e.g., Type 2 diabetes, hypertension, cardiac/respiratory disease)?

new_facts.label: Previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity
new_facts.ask: Does the record document a prior attempt at medical (non-surgical) treatment for obesity that was unsuccessful?

new_facts.label: Bariatric surgery procedure type and approach
new_facts.ask: What specific bariatric surgery procedure is being requested, and is it open or laparoscopic?

not_modeled.quote: Effective for dates of service on and after February 21, 2006, these procedures are only covered when performed at facilities that are: (1) certified by the American College of Surgeons as a Level 1 Bariatric Surgery Center...or (2) certified by the American Society for Bariatric Surgery as a Bariatric Surgery Center of Excellence...Effective for dates of service on and after September 24, 2013, facilities are no longer required to be certified.
not_modeled.why: This is a time-limited historical facility-certification requirement that no longer applies as of the policy's current effective date (09/24/2013); not a testable ongoing criterion for current prior authorization.

not_modeled.quote: Effective for services performed on and after June 27, 2012, Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs) acting within their respective jurisdictions may determine coverage of stand-alone laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (LSG)
not_modeled.why: Coverage is left to local MAC discretion and may vary; this is a jurisdictional/administrative note rather than a single testable national criterion.

not_modeled.quote: The determination of coverage for any bariatric surgery procedures that are not specifically identified in an NCD as covered or non-covered...is left to the local MACs.
not_modeled.why: Delegates coverage decision to local MAC discretion; not a fixed national testable criterion.
